03 다음 우리말에 맞도록 [보기]에서 적절한 단어를 골라 빈칸에 쓰시오. (필요시 어형을 바꿀 것)
[보기] wish, comfort, provide, recognize, decide
(1) 나는 이 의자에서 편안함을 느낀다.
→ I feel ______ in this chair.
(2) 나는 그녀의 목소리를 쉽게 알아볼 수 있다.
→ I can ______ her voice easily.
(3) 나는 오늘 결정을 내려야 한다.
→ I need to make a ______ today.
세 칸을 쉼표로 구분하여 차례대로 쓰시오.

choices: A: Have you heard about self-driving cars? B: Yes, I have. They can stop by themselves if there is something in the way.
A: Are you familiar with AI technology? B: I'm familiar with it. It can recognize faces and recommend videos.
A: Have you heard of this new app? B: No, I haven't. What is it about?
A: Have you heard that AI can now write poems and stories? B: Yes, I do. I think it is very interesting.
A: Do you know what a smart refrigerator is? B: I know about that. It can scan the things inside and show you recipes.

questions.promptEn:
M: Hi, everyone! Today's special guest is Emma Brown. She has made a lot of amazing items.
W: Hi! Thanks for having me today.
M: Thank you for coming. Please tell us about your new item. (①)
W: (②) Sure. I made smart glasses. Have you heard about them? (③)
M: (④) What is special about these glasses?
W: (⑤) They can show digital information, such as maps, in front of your eyes.
M: Wow! Then I don't need to use my smartphone for directions anymore.
W: <u>ⓐ Exactly</u>. Also, they can recognize your voice and send texts.
M: I'm surprised that glasses can do all that! Can I take a look?
W: Of course. Let me show you.

05 위 대화의 ①~⑤ 중 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?
Yes, I have, but I don't know much about them.

User: Hi, nice to meet you!
ANNIE: Hello! Nice to meet you, too! I'm your AI friend ANNIE. I can answer ANY questions that you have. How can I help you?
User: Can I ask you some questions about AI?
ANNIE: Sure! I'd be happy to answer your questions!
User: My first question is: What is AI?
ANNIE: AI stands for "Artificial Intelligence." It is a kind of computer system. AI can understand language, learn from experiences, and make decisions like humans.

questions.promptEn:
User: It is hard to understand your <u>ⓐ explanation</u>. Can you give me an example?
ANNIE: Sure! (①) Imagine that you have a new pet dog. (②) And you want to teach it how to sit and stay. (③) Your dog will learn from information and experiences. (④) But you don't have to give AI a snack! (⑤)
User: How is AI used in <u>ⓑ everyday life</u>?
ANNIE: AI is used in many situations. <u>(a) For example</u>, AI technology can <u>ⓒ recommend</u> new videos that you may like.
(A) AI can also recognize your face to <u>ⓓ unlock</u> your smartphone.
(B) It studies which videos you have already watched.
(C) Then it decides what to recommend.
It learns what your face looks like. <u>ⓔ Over time</u>, it gets better at recognizing you, even if you change your hair or wear a mask.
